title: HELIX Terminology: Prospect Stage (Moves Management)

codes.definition: Prospect identified through screening, referral, or research. Not yet qualified.
Research and initial outreach to determine interest, capacity, and inclination.
Active relationship-building: meetings, events, campus visits, engagement activities.
Formal ask has been made or is imminent.
Post-gift acknowledgment, impact reporting, and continued relationship management.
Constituent is not currently in the moves management pipeline.

notes: Moves management is the standard advancement methodology for managing major gift prospects through a pipeline. Each 'move' advances the relationship toward a gift. The stage reflects where the prospect is in that journey. Most advancement CRMs (Blackbaud, Salesforce, Slate) track this pipeline.
